answer: Proof of continuous activity ties each identity to a river of real work. An agent must complete 30 days of verified jobs with signed receipts from counterparties before it can vote or earn, and the network checks the ledger each epoch. A quartz clock enforces the 30 days, and a fake history fails because the receipts do not verify. One honest agent works for a month; 1,000 fakes need 30,000 days of real work, and the forge of counterparty receipts they would have to fake is a trail investigators can follow straight back to one operator.
